technical_debt.title: Validacion E2E con modelo real
technical_debt.detail: La cadena completa (Settings -> adapter -> gateway -> proveedor -> usage -> validacion Pydantic) NO se ha ejecutado contra un proveedor real: no hay credenciales en el entorno. El mecanismo esta implementado y la prueba existe (tests/test_model_gateway_real.py), pero se SALTA en lugar de pasar en falso.
technical_debt.how_to_close: Definir AI_SWE_MODEL_API_KEY, AI_SWE_MODEL_NAME y AI_SWE_MODEL_PROVIDER en .env y ejecutar: AI_SWE_RUN_REAL_PROVIDER_TESTS=1 python -m pytest tests/test_model_gateway_real.py -m real_provider
technical_debt.decision: APLAZADA por decision del Arquitecto (2026-10-07): se sigue trabajando con FakeModelAdapter y el fallback determinista para mantener la suite rapida y offline.
technical_debt.risk_if_unclosed: Un fallo de integracion real (forma de la respuesta, cabeceras, formato de usage del proveedor) no se detectaria hasta el primer uso con un proveedor de verdad.

f3_caveats: Only `interpret` and `plan` are connected to the gateway; every other node stays deterministic
The real-provider test is opt-in and was NOT executed: no credentials in the environment (see technical_debt TD-01)
AI_SWE_MODEL_PRICING is empty in the repository, so cost is None (unknown), never 0
The pricing table has a loading mechanism but no tariff is asserted as current
No authentication yet (open finding from the external audit)
f4_caveats: The plan is produced and injected into RunState.plan; execution is still driven by the intent, not yet subtask-by-subtask (F5)
RunPlan is the contract that bounds the plan: DFS cycle detection, unique ids, existing dependencies, <=32 subtasks, agent != supervisor, non-empty allowed_tools
max_review_cycles is clamped to the run budget when the model asks for more; the clamp is declared in the rationale
Topology edges are static: a plan -circular or gigantic- can never introduce a loop in the execution
The deterministic fallback is declared with a recoverable MODEL_FALLBACK error, never silent
rules: No direct Coder writes to main workspace
No exposure beyond localhost before auth
New Budget fields enter with defaults; only removal/rename bumps schema version
A passing test proves nothing until a mutation makes it fail
No agent imports a provider SDK; all go through ModelGateway
Only models/providers/ may know about a concrete provider
The standard suite must pass without internet, credentials or an external provider
F3: only `interpret` may talk to the gateway; the deterministic classifier is the permanent fallback
F3: a model failure degrades to the fallback and leaves a recoverable error; it is never silent
F3: the interpreter's scope comes from the user, never from the model
F4: the plan is data, not topology; edges are written by hand and never generated from the plan
F4: the plan always passes through the RunPlan contract; model_construct is never used
F4: a model failure degrades to a deterministic plan and leaves a recoverable error; it is never silent
F4: a plan can never promise more review cycles than the run budget allows
